onboarding.title: रुको · Ruko
onboarding.subtitle: Take a moment before you decide · फ़ैसले से पहले एक पल रुकें

signals.late_night: It is {{hour}}:00. Late-night decisions are often rushed.
signals.many_trades_today: This would be trade number {{count}} today.
signals.quick_reentry_after_loss: Your last trade was a loss, {{minutes}} minutes ago.
signals.size_escalation: This amount is much bigger than your last few trades.
signals.loss_streak: Your last 3 closed trades were all losses.
signals.risky_funding: This money is marked as emergency or loan money.

snippets.snip_1: A 20% loss needs a 25% gain to get back to where you started.
snippets.snip_2: A 50% loss needs a 100% gain to get back to where you started.
snippets.snip_3: SEBI's own study found that about 9 out of 10 individual F&O traders made a net loss.
snippets.snip_4: Money you cannot afford to lose is the hardest money to trade calmly.

home.pending_reflection_desc: You have an unreviewed decision from last night.
home.try_practice_desc: Try practice mode, no real money

pause.mirror_disclaimer: Nothing here is a verdict. It is a mirror.
pause.q_why: Why are you making this trade?
pause.why_card_title: Why are you making this trade? One line is enough.
pause.q_funding: Where is this money coming from?
pause.q_amount: How much are you putting in? (₹)
pause.q_loss: How much loss can you accept? (₹)
pause.body_card_text: Unclench your jaw. Drop your shoulders. Take three slow breaths.
pause.mirror_card_text: On {{date}} you wrote: "{{why}}". Afterwards you felt: {{feeling}}.
pause.why_min_chars_prompt: Please write at least 3 characters for why before deciding
pause.courage_quote: That took a moment of courage. Nothing to prove.
pause.q_morning: Would you make this same decision at 2 pm tomorrow?
pause.q_revenge: Are you trying to win back the last loss, or is there a fresh reason?
pause.q_money: What was this money meant for? Will that still be covered if you lose it?
pause.q_count: What did your earlier trades today teach you?
pause.q_size: Why is this amount bigger than usual?
pause.q_plan_or_reaction: Is this a plan or a reaction?
pause.q_friend: What would you tell a friend who was about to do this?
pause.q_week: Will this still matter a week from now?
pause.q_source: Where did this idea come from?
pause.practice_banner: The practice market is paused while you pause.

trigger_labels.revenge: wanting to win back a loss

journal.title: Decision Journal
journal.summary: {{n}} pauses this week, {{k}} trades abandoned or delayed.
journal.morning_prompt: How do you feel about that decision now?
journal.empty_desc: Take a pause before you enter the market to reflect here.

mirror.title: Weekly Mirror
mirror.subtitle: Decisions over the last 7 days
mirror.empty_title: No activity in the last 7 days
mirror.empty_desc: Your behavioral mirror will appear here once you record your first pause.
mirror.support_card: Trading repeatedly with borrowed money can get heavy. Consider talking to someone you trust. For investor complaints, see SEBI SCORES (scores.sebi.gov.in).

trades.title: Trades
trades.empty_desc: Log a trade in 3 taps or import CSV to track your patterns.
trades.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all trades?

rules.title: Personal Rules
rules.subtitle: Your rules will be shown to you during high pressure checks
rules.rule_1: I take a 30 minute break after any loss.
rules.rule_2: I never trade with emergency or loan money.

settings.title: Settings
settings.delete_confirm: Are you sure you want to delete all data? This cannot be undone.
settings.privacy_note: Everything stays on this phone. Nothing is uploaded.

practice.banner: Practice money. Not real. Prices are random and cannot be predicted.
practice.title: Practice Simulator

scenarios.volatile_desc: Big swings both ways. Notice how it feels.
scenarios.crash_desc: A sudden drop after a calm start.
scenarios.rally_reversal_desc: Everything seems to go up. Then it does not.

practice.auto_close_notice: Position closed automatically because losses reached the limit.

debrief.title: Session Debrief
debrief.closing_disclaimer: Practice results say nothing about real markets. What matters is what you noticed about yourself.
debrief.self_reflection_prompt: What did you notice about yourself?
debrief.self_reflection_placeholder: Notice your heart rate, urges, revenge impulses, or hesitation...

ai_badge.explanation: Written by an AI from the sentence you typed. It cannot see your trades or amounts, and it never gives advice on what to trade.

ai_consent.title: Smart reflection (AI), optional
ai_consent.subtitle: When AI is on, only these leave your device:
ai_consent.item_why: The typed why text (or aggregate counts for summaries)
ai_consent.privacy_note: 🔒 Never amounts, trades, funding source, names, or personal identifiers.
